{{- /* Body prose from the contract. Rich text can carry inline images, and the exporter hands them over as contract paths ("images/…") exactly like a cover or a logo — so they need resolving against the site root the same way img.html does. That one substitution is what makes an inline image work at a domain root, under the platform's // prefix, and in the designer preview alike. Arg: the page's .Content. */ -}} {{- replace . "src=\"images/" (printf "src=\"%simages/" site.Home.RelPermalink) | safeHTML -}}
